description: attestations validly BIP-322 signed by burn key #1 with one value that whitespace pads (SPEC §2.2): a verifier reads each value as written, at input.now and against input.expected_aud, so each case's reason is the code its padded value gives (bond_malformed, aud_mismatch, expired, decode_error for an identity or an issued_at, bad_request for an address that is not input.address), and the control's is null; a case's builder says whether a builder writes its identities and extensions as given or refuses them
